# Greek Souvlaki Kafr Yasif

> Official website for a Greek restaurant on Route 70 in Kafr Yasif, Western Galilee, Israel.

Use the pages below as the primary sources for current public information. Prices and availability may change; the live menu is authoritative.

## Key facts

- Cuisine: Greek; souvlaki, gyros, grilled skewers, pita, platters and salads.
- Address: Route 70, Kafr Yasif, Western Galilee, Israel.
- Hours: Wednesday–Saturday, 13:00–00:00; closed Sunday–Tuesday.
- Telephone: 04-812-2980.
- WhatsApp: 052-892-1454.
- Dietary options: vegan items and a gluten-free pita option are listed on the menu. Guests with allergies should confirm preparation details directly with the restaurant.
